database_triggers.name: ck_asset_status_insert
database_triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER ck_asset_status_insert BEFORE INSERT ON assets WHEN NEW.current_status NOT IN ('AVAILABLE','IN_USE','MAINTENANCE','RETIRED','DISPOSED') OR NEW.current_status IS NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Invalid asset status'); END

database_triggers.name: ck_asset_status_update
database_triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER ck_asset_status_update BEFORE UPDATE ON assets WHEN NEW.current_status NOT IN ('AVAILABLE','IN_USE','MAINTENANCE','RETIRED','DISPOSED') OR NEW.current_status IS NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Invalid asset status'); END
